column1: The Causes of Hyperinflation Why do hyperinflations start, and how do they end? This question can be answered at different levels. The most obvious answer is that hyperinflations are due to excessive growth in the supply of money. When the central bank prints money, the price level rises. When it prints money rapidly enough, the result is hyperinflation. To stop the hyperinflation, the central bank must reduce the rate of money growth.
